endorsements.name: Zhang Yuqing
endorsements.label: CVE-2025-2151
endorsements.description: A vulnerability classified as critical was found in Open Asset Import Library Assimp 5.4.3. This vulnerability affects the function Assimp::GetNextLine in the library ParsingUtils.h of the component File Handler. The manipulation leads to stack-based buffer overflow. The attack can be initiated remotely. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: UNKNOWN (CVSS 2.0, 7.5)

endorsements.name: Zhang Yuqing
endorsements.label: CVE-2025-2152
endorsements.description: A vulnerability, which was classified as critical, has been found in Open Asset Import Library Assimp 5.4.3. This issue affects the function Assimp::BaseImporter::ConvertToUTF8 of the file BaseImporter.cpp of the component File Handler. The manipulation leads to heap-based buffer overflow. The attack may be initiated remotely. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used.

endorsements.name: Zhang Yuqing
endorsements.label: CVE-2025-2153
endorsements.description: A vulnerability, which was classified as critical, was found in HDF5 1.14.6. Affected is the function H5SM_delete of the file H5SM.c of the component h5 File Handler. The manipulation leads to heap-based buffer overflow. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The complexity of an attack is rather high. The exploitability is told to be difficult. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used.
